title: Diabetes emergency snack and insulin timing note
summary: A non-dosing continuity card for people who already have a diabetes plan and need food, timing notes, cooling awareness, and escalation boundaries during disruption.
content: Core sequence: 1) Follow the person’s existing medical plan; record times for food, medicine, symptoms, and any missed dose without inventing a new dose. 2) Keep rapid snack items and longer-lasting food separated and labeled for the named person. 3) Protect insulin or supplies from heat, freezing, sunlight, and confused sharing. 4) Seek medical help urgently for severe confusion, unconsciousness, persistent vomiting, breathing difficulty, or symptoms not matching the written plan.
